messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout quant_v2 to eu-west (canary=c-17) — health probes are reporting a 503 spike. 5xx rate 3.6% over last 3m > abort threshold 2%.
sam_oncall: saw alerts. pulling traces and metrics now. @lee_infra @maria_sre can you confirm node/infra side?
deploy-bot: probe logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] GET /health -> 503 (probe) x37
[2026-03-17T10:12:05Z] upstream model=quant_v2 instance=gw-12 status=5xx
[2026-03-17T10:12:07Z] downstream timeout 1200ms
```
lee_infra: ack, checking autoscaler and recent pod restarts — seeing repeated liveness failures on gw-12 and gw-14. kube events show OOMKilled on quant_v2 sidecars.
maria_sre: per abort-runbook this meets canary abort. Recommend immediate feature-flag kill-switch + traffic shift to fallback pool.
sam_oncall: agreed. @deploy-bot execute: feature_flag.disable rollout_eu_quant_v2 --env=prod --scope=eu-west
deploy-bot: executed: feature_flag.disable rollout_eu_quant_v2 -> success (req_id=abc123)
pagerduty: INCIDENT PD-4521 opened and assigned to sam_oncall — Severity: high — symptom: canary 5xx surge eu-west
cs_lead: any confirmed customer impact yet? which accounts are in c-17?
eng_platform: small beta group only: acct-879 and acct-412 are in canary c-17. No broad production routing affected — traffic isolation held.
lee_infra: initiating traffic shift to legacy pool: route shift --from quant_v2 --to quant_v1 --region eu-west --canary c-17 --percent 100
deploy-bot: running route shift command:
```
route shift --from quant_v2 --to quant_v1 --region eu-west --percent 100 --canary c-17
```
deploy-bot: shift started -> completed in 3s (ops_req=shift-789)
sam_oncall: metrics update: 5xx dropping from 3.6% -> 0.4% over last 1m. latency back to baseline :thumbsup:
maria_sre: good containment. Keep 15m monitoring window and capture heap/alloc profiles from quant_v2 instances for postmortem.
cs_lead: notifying acct-879 and acct-412 now. Will share that we rolled back canary and are investigating root cause.
sam_oncall: creating short incident note, will handoff to night oncall @lee_infra for watch. escalate if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m.
lee_infra: ack — setting a temporary alert.rules: if 5xx > 1% for 5m -> page oncall.
deploy-bot: marking PD-4521 as mitigated by rollback + traffic shift. Logging mitigation steps to incident record.
sam_oncall: opening postmortem ticket with timeline, logs, and customer notifications. assigning to eng-ml + infra for root cause (probable memory regression in quant_v2). thanks everyone for fast coordination.
lee_infra: will follow up on kube events and OOM traces overnight. leaving alerts in place.
deploy-bot: incident thread closed (mitigated) — handoff recorded.
